evidence.snippet: template_str = re.sub(r"{{\s*(\w+)\|safe\s*}}", lambda m: str(context.get(m.group(1), "")), template_str)
evidence.why: Explicit 'safe' passthrough injects user-supplied notification_message directly into HTML with no sanitisation.

def replace_vars(match):
    var_name = match.group(1).strip()
    value = context.get(var_name, "")
    return str(value) if value is not None else ""
